base.source: freshly fitted TRR-0004 historical-style full affine state selected by Track A

state_artifact.binding_role: fresh public-data affine base selected by Track A; no inherited weak tied-CE checkpoint

cost_plan.conservative_peak_estimate: runner computes table + selected-logit autograd copies + full sequence hidden/workspace from actual input geometry; estimate is not a measured result until qualification
cost_plan.preflight: qualify the largest public geometry before full fit; require at least 8 GiB free CUDA memory, at most 6 GiB current reservation, and at most 16 GiB host RSS; default wall guard is 1,200 seconds
cost_plan.preparation: public activation/truth tensor capture is external to this runner and must be recorded by its own receipt
cost_plan.runner: one embedding-table transfer, two main fits, two 8-record subset overfit diagnostics, public validation at registered checkpoints

dataset.labels: public current-token labels only; fit and validation IDs must exactly match the supplied combined registration
dataset.rendering: registered Alpaca Llama chat recipe at cut-4, maximum sequence length 192
dataset.validation_group_balance: style-balanced mean over the two explicit 24-record groups

registration_asset: footing-provided combined registration with the 1200-record public fit split and two explicit validation groups

runtime_contract.deployed_inputs: cut-4 activation sequence, fixed normalized public embedding table, selected extension state

shared_algorithm.context_input: activation H_0 through H_i with causal validity mask; no token or teacher input
shared_algorithm.position_budget_scope: total selected positions per record batch, not per record
shared_algorithm.projection: full vocabulary logits materialized only for selected loss rows, at most 512 per batch
shared_algorithm.sampler: one precomputed seed-bound record/position schedule saved and reused byte-identically by both methods
shared_algorithm.selection: step 0 is retained as the exact-base diagnostic; selected deployment state is earliest best NONZERO checkpoint by style-balanced public validation token accuracy
